requirements.requirement: The system must execute unit tests that validate correct credibility_score assignment for NIH sponsors.
The system must execute unit tests that validate correct credibility_score assignment for Industry sponsors.
The system must execute unit tests that validate correct credibility_score assignment for Academic sponsors (inferred or explicit).
The system must execute unit tests that validate correct credibility_score assignment for Other or unknown sponsor types.
The system must verify via unit tests that credibility_score values are normalized between 0 and 1 inclusive.
The system must validate through unit tests that missing lead_sponsor data results in a deterministic fallback credibility_score.
The system must validate through unit tests that presence of multiple collaborators influences the final credibility_score according to defined rules.
The system must validate through unit tests that collaborator-only scenarios (no lead sponsor) still produce a valid credibility_score.
The system must verify via unit tests that explanation text is generated and non-empty for each scoring outcome.
The system must execute an integration test confirming that the evaluation API response includes a sponsor_credibility object.
The system must verify via integration test that the sponsor_credibility object contains sponsor_type, credibility_score, and explanation fields.
The system must verify via integration test that credibility_score in the API response matches the value produced by the scoring logic.
The system must handle and test the exception case where sponsor metadata is completely absent without causing runtime errors.
The system must handle and test the exception case where sponsor agency_class values are invalid or unrecognized and still return a valid fallback score.
